title:
Used to handle user navigating away from asset's data preparation.
The epic handles following things:
1. Force redirect to asset's data prep page: On 'Reliability.AssetDataPreparationPageTitle.ACTIVE_TAB_SET', the epic
     - Starts listening to any GLOBAL_REDIRECT's happening and force redirects user back to asset's data prep page via {@link NavigationHelper#handleForceBackRedirect}.
     - The epic also stores the page user originally intended to navigate to in application state and opens a warning modal.
     - Stops helper from listening, when GLOBAL_REDIRECT is fired with payload having 'exitAnyway' parameter set to true.

2. Exit anyway from asset's data prep page: On 'GLOBAL_REDIRECT' with 'exitAnyway' set to true, the epic
   - Fires 'GLOBAL_REDIRECT' to page user originally intended to navigate to and clear relevant component state.
   - Fires 'Reliability.DataPreparationApplicationState.EXIT_AND_RESET' which is handled in {@link DataPreparationLoadDefaultSettingsEpic}
name: ExitDataPreparationEpic
